name: TenantLedgerStatement
tagline: Tenant ledgers, payment allocation, aging, late fees and printable statements – in one Power Platform control.
description: A complete accounts-receivable app for leases: AR dashboard, tenant accounts, a ledger with running balance and payment allocation (Applied to, FIFO or charge-code priority), late fee rules, aging buckets, collections stages from reminder to legal, and a printable statement of account with remittance slip. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Payment allocation: Applied to, oldest first or charge-code priority
Aging by due date (not yet due, 1–30, 31–60, 61–90, 90+)
Late fee rules (flat or %, grace days, codes, minimum) with one-click run
Collections stages with rules: reminder, final notice, payment plan, legal, closed
Running balance, void and dispute with audit trail
Printable statement with period selection and remittance slip
Live allocation preview in the payment form
pack: Niray Real Estate & Facilities PCF Pack
